I like to save empty jars and re-use them for nearly everything.
Uses include but are not limited to:

  • Take a drink or something to eat with you
  • Put leftovers in the fridge without having to smell them (also, you won't need to use that valuable plastic wrap)
  • Decoration I: fill one third with some underground like sand or small gravel, add a tealight, swiggity swooty.
  • Decoration II: use them as plant pots.
  • Catch spiders, make them your pet, feed them with flies
  • Keep easy to lose stuff in there. Screws, nails, jewelry, condoms, your dignity.
Use empty glass jars (like from yogurt, jelly, bee vomit) as a lunchbox.
Perfect in the kitchen for spices, and stuff where the box just falls apart anyway like toothpicks. :) http://i.imgur.com/UvA6wZD.jpg
I use my empty glass jars to hold cold brewed coffee in the fridge and freezer. Best instant coffee ever.
I've saved quite a few pasta sauce jars. They are great for storing dry goods like lentils or beans!

I love a particular brand of bottled tea, but I can hardly ever find it, but they come in a glass bottle, and I use those bottles for everything. Hot drinks, cold drinks, soup, cheezits, anything that I need in a jar, and I probably won't need a lot of/keep it around very long, it goes in those jars. The tea itself is a little pricey, but I love those jars.
